Wix SEO: what you can change, and where

For small businesses that want to build and edit the site themselves. Here’s what you can change for search on Wix, and where each setting is. Every answer is checked against Wix’s own help docs.

Answers checked October 2026 · Hosted website builder

What people ask most often, with the menu path to each setting.

Is Wix right for you?

The short version, from the CMS Picker profile.

Type
Hosted website builder
Starts at
Free plan with a Wix address; paid plans from $17.77/mo billed yearly
Hosting and updates
Handled for you
Take with you
No full-site export; products, contacts and CMS collections as CSV

A good fit for

  • Small businesses and local services
  • Owners who build and edit the site themselves
  • Getting online quickly

Less suited when

  • You need complex custom functionality or a very large site
  • You need template or server-level control

What’s built in

  • Run a blogBuilt inWix Blog, a free Wix app
  • Sell onlineBuilt invariesWix Stores; taking payments needs a paid plan that accepts them (not Light)
  • Use more than one languageBuilt inWix Multilingual, with hreflang tags added for you
  • Add contact and sign-up formsBuilt inWix Forms
  • Design every detailBuilt invariesVisually in the editor; Wix Studio adds full responsive control and CSS
